The following events happened during the year '''6,000 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Manderon Period]] reaches its height.
*[[Rheshalva Interstellar Armaments/Legends|Rheshalva Interstellar Armaments]] is formed
*The planet [[Ession]] had already been settled.
*Intelligent life, in the form of the [[Altiri/Legends|Altiri]] and the [[Anarrian]]s, first appeared on [[Altiria/Anarris]].<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
